# dsh-chatgpt-plan
English | 中文
## Summary
Use your ChatGPT plan to run DSH tasks through OpenAI's official Sign in with ChatGPT flow. This bun
dle adds the `codex-plan` provider and account controls in Settings → Models. Each user authorizes t
heir own account; eligible requests consume their existing plan allowance. The plugin uses the publi
c Responses API and keeps DSH's agent loop and tools. It is an independent integration, not an OpenA
I or DeepSeek endorsement.
## Screenshots

## Use this package
### Requirements and installation
Use Node.js ≥24.9 and DSH **0.2.1-rc.5**, **0.2.2-alpha.2**, or **0.2.2-rc.1**. This version targets
profiles based on `dsh-base`, including Web, Desktop and headless; other DSH versions are rejected
by its compatibility declaration. You need a ChatGPT account eligible for SIWC plan usage, with plan
usage granted during authorization. Browser sign-in and model discovery have been verified with a r
eal account. Real-account inference remains unverified.
Download the prebuilt package from GitHub Releases and install it without a build step:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart an already running DSH after installation. GitHub source archives do not contain built code;
use the release `.tgz` for installation.
In Desktop, install the local `.tgz` or its release download URL through the plugin manager, then re
start Desktop. Use 0.1.4 for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1. Version 0.1.3 supports the two older versions above; 0.
1.2 supports only DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2. Do not disable compatibility checks.
From this checkout, install the built plugin into a CLI-managed profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The composed configuration contains the `dsh-chatgpt-plan` bundle and `codex-plan` row. Restart an a
lready running DSH after installation. The bundle enables the existing `credentials` and `authorizat
ion` rows, including when a headless profile disabled them. Their storage is the DSH credential stor
e, shared by profiles using that store. Desktop owns its own profile; install the tarball through it
s plugin manager rather than using the CLI's Web profile.
For distribution without a source checkout, build and pack the plugin:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
This package is not published to npm. The tarball contains built Host and browser code and requires
no installation-time build. Removing the plugin with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-chatgpt-pl
an` removes its bundle layer; credential records remain in the DSH store.
### Sign in and select a model
Open Settings → Models → ChatGPT plan and choose Continue with ChatGPT. Open the authorization link,
sign in on OpenAI's page, and allow plan usage. When the browser cannot reach the DSH Host's loopba
ck listener, paste the complete callback URL into the account card. The card reports success only af
ter token verification and credential storage. Then select a model under ChatGPT plan in DSH's model
verification and credential storage. Then select a model under ChatGPT plan in DSH's model selector.
Use Cancel sign-in to withdraw a pending attempt. Sign out stops this instance's account requests, a
ttempts remote revocation and clears local tokens; it retains the host ID and account/client registr
ation for later sign-in. If remote revocation cannot be confirmed, the card reports it and directs y
ou to disconnect the application in ChatGPT settings. Manage usage opens ChatGPT's app limits and cr
ct the application in ChatGPT settings. Manage usage opens ChatGPT's app limits and credit settings.

Override the `codex-plan` row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. DSH applies defaults from the pl
ugin schema for omitted fields. Changes require remounting the plugin or restarting DSH.

## Understand the implementation
Implementation and development
[该节后续省略]
#### What the model sees
The model receives DSH's retained text history and tools grouped under the `dsh` namespace, describe
d as `Tools executed by DeepSeek Harness.` Tool results correlate by call ID. Validated native reaso
ning and response items are replayed only for the same model and login generation, with unchanged vi
sible content. The adapter adds no persona or task instructions.
## Known Limitations and Deferred Work
- One account registration per credential store; multi-account selection and workspace switching are

not implemented.
- Text input and DSH function tools are supported. The adapter advertises text-onl

y input so DSH projects attachments; native image/file input and hosted tools are not exposed.
- Mod
el availability comes from the account catalog. Reasoning choices are limited to efforts also suppor
ted by the installed Responses SDK; extra server-advertised efforts do not invalidate a model. Unkno
wn or unavailable models are refused. Catalog metadata can be incomplete; context overrides are expl

icit.
- Web installation and keyless headless execution are verified on macOS. Desktop-native behavi

or, Windows ACL protection and real-account inference remain unverified.
- The callback listener mus
t bind its configured loopback port. A busy default port fails visibly; configure another port or `0
